candidates.fdm: No new solids. Disc orbits at 2-omega.
candidates.name: oldham_pose
candidates.why: Left-out comment names this law and refuses to invent it. Textbook. Highest-value coupling play. Couplings slice already ranked it high.

candidates.fdm: No new solids. Cardan tangent places the spider.
candidates.name: hooke_pose
candidates.why: cv_velocity_ratio is speed only. The gallery said so. Unlocks Hooke and is the block for double_cardan_pose.

candidates.api_shape: ANIMATE demo_iris_diaphragm(close_pct) via sine of drive_deg onto 0..100. close_pct already exists
candidates.fdm: No new solids. Reason in the left-out comment is stale: lazy_tongs already does this mapping.
candidates.name: iris_play
candidates.why: Nine bodies, the iris actually opening. The demo already has close_pct. Wire it.

candidates.api_shape: ANIMATE demo_knuckle_hinge(open_deg) sine-mapped between stop_deg and 180
candidates.fdm: No new solids. open_deg already exists.
candidates.name: knuckle_play
candidates.why: Same stale 'bounded travel' reason. The hinge swinging is the point of the demo.

candidates.fdm: No new solids. extend already exists.
candidates.name: telescoping_play
candidates.why: Left-out said the cycle does not close. screw_jack already closed an open lift with a cosine. Same trick.

candidates.api_shape: demo takes drive_deg; nut_z = z0 + lead * turns(sine). Same for differential_screw (travel = p1-p2)
candidates.fdm: No new solids. Demos today are static.
candidates.name: lead_screw_play
candidates.why: The rotary-to-linear primitive does not play. screw_jack already does. lead_screw and differential_screw are the same law.

candidates.api_shape: scroll_drive(..., phase_deg) rotates the plate and poses jaws at face_r + spiral_pitch * turns
candidates.fdm: No new solids. travel_per_rev is already in metadata.
candidates.name: scroll_pose
candidates.why: Three jaws walking a spiral is the picture people want. Demo is static at face_r.

candidates.fdm: No new solids. Without this law a constant-ratio bake drives the lock into the notch.
candidates.name: intermittent_gear_pose
candidates.why: Left-out is still true and is a real gap. Same class as geneva_wheel_angle / escapement_pose.

candidates.api_shape: add phase_deg, rotate the rotor, ANIMATE 360/n_rollers closed or 360 open
candidates.fdm: Rotor is rigid. Body and cap are ground. One turn closes.
candidates.name: peristaltic_play
candidates.why: A pump demo that does not turn. Trivial rigid repose. Rollers are 3-fold; a 120 deg closed track may work.

candidates.api_shape: two hooke_pose at equal angles, 90-deg intermediate
candidates.fdm: No new solids once hooke_pose exists.
candidates.name: double_cardan_pose
candidates.why: Five-body CV. Depends on hooke_pose. Intermediate still fluctuates; that is the teaching point.

candidates.api_shape: add travel to the demo, cosine-map like rack_pinion
candidates.fdm: Carriage translates on a fixed rail. Cycle closes on the same pose.
candidates.name: linear_way_play
candidates.why: Same stale open-interval reason as telescoping. Needs a new demo kwarg; the kit already poses the carriage centred.

candidates.api_shape: ANIMATE demo_roller_follower(pose_deg) sine-mapped on the arm swing
candidates.fdm: pose_deg already exists. Three rigid bodies.
candidates.name: roller_follower_play
candidates.why: The follower demo is not wired. Not a cam pair (plate_cam already plays); it is the arm+roller kit rocking.

candidates.api_shape: add phase_deg, rotate the flight in the trough
candidates.fdm: Helix has no rotational symmetry at a useful pitch, so 360 deg / 24 frames is visible. Not a camera move.
candidates.name: archimedes_play
candidates.why: A screw that does not turn. Distinct from timing_pulley (a toothless spin of a symmetric sheave).

candidates.api_shape: ratchet_pose(phase) -> wheel_deg + pawl_lift, one tooth per cycle, like escapement_pose
candidates.fdm: No new solids. Spring leaf on ratchet_wheel_pawl deforms slightly; gate may need ALLOW or a rigid pawl-only bake.
candidates.name: ratchet_pose
candidates.why: Four ratchet demos sit still. One law plays all of them. detent_pair is the plunger cousin.

candidates.api_shape: sine-map bend_deg (already on the demo) across the designed range
candidates.fdm: 24 bodies. Pose exists. Heavy bake, but the law is there.
candidates.name: drag_chain_play
candidates.why: A cable carrier that does not articulate. bend_deg is already a demo param.

candidates.api_shape: demo variant without the D-flat, then a one-tooth closed track or 2520 deg / 252 frames
candidates.fdm: The law exists (carrier = sun * zs/(zs+zr)). The D-flat is what kills the short track.
candidates.name: planet_stage_roundbore
candidates.why: Left-out is still true of the current demo. A round-bore bake demo is a demo change, not a new law. Feasible, previously judged not worth 252 frames.

candidates.api_shape: if conjugate contact measures non-zero, add phase and ANIMATE; else same reject as demo_worm
candidates.fdm: Demo is display-posed with a fixed 11.3 deg wheel clock. Measure overlap before wiring.
candidates.name: flat_worm_play
candidates.why: demo_worm is still invalid (no contact). printed/flat worms exist specifically to mesh. If the coupon pair contacts, it can play; do not assert a drive sense.

candidates.fdm: Cup deforms every frame. Gate rejects ~0.15 mm residual.
candidates.name: harmonic_play
candidates.why: Still true. A spinning wave generator with a frozen cup lies about the ratio.

candidates.fdm: Whole assembly rotates. Picture is a camera orbit.
candidates.name: jaw_hirth_timing_spin
candidates.why: Left-out still true. freewheel rollers walking the ramps would be a different demo.

candidates.fdm: A lock-once adjustment.
candidates.name: eccentric_idler
candidates.why: Prompt said do not propose this. Correct. Animating it claims the part spins in service.

candidates.already: collet_chuck, leaf_spring, spiral_power_spring, bistable_beam, auxetic, kerf
candidates.fdm: Rigid-recovery gate rejects strain by design.
candidates.name: deforming_kits
candidates.why: Still true. Not a pose-law gap.

candidates.fdm: No conjugate contact. Interpenetrates 93 mm^3.
candidates.name: worm_display
candidates.why: Still true. Drive sense cannot be recovered from the geometry.

rejected.name: animate_static_explode
rejected.why: Explode sliders on jaw/oldham/torque_limiter are presentation, not mechanism motion.

rejected.name: single_link_chain
rejected.why: demo_drag_chain_link and demo_roller_chain_link are one link. The run (demo_drag_chain / demo_roller_chain) is the playable object.

summary:
ANIMATE is 36 entries. catalog lists 80 multi-body movement demos; 45 of them do not play. The left-out comment in gallery/build_gallery.py was measured, but several reasons are stale: the same file already sine/cosine-maps bounded travels onto a 360 deg drive_deg for peaucellier, watt, sarrus, lazy_tongs, screw_jack, rack_pinion, and dog_clutch. That pattern unlocks iris, knuckle, telescoping, linear_way, lead_screw, and check_valve without a new theory. A second bucket is missing pose laws that the couplings and cams slices already named (oldham, Hooke, double Cardan, intermittent gears). A third is rigid rotation that is visible (helical flight, peristaltic rotor, scroll plate) and only needs a phase kwarg. Do not animate static adjustments (eccentric_idler_mount) or all-bodies-together spins (jaw, hirth, timing_pulley, idler). Do not claim deformation (harmonic cup, collet, flexure springs, kerf) until the rigid-recovery gate changes.

Stale reasons. iris_diaphragm already takes close_pct; knuckle_hinge already takes open_deg; telescoping_stage already takes extend. All three are the exact out-and-back the comment said a linear ramp cannot express, and the gallery already solved that with a sine. linear_way has no travel param yet; adding one and cosine-mapping it is the screw_jack pattern. lead_screw / differential_screw / scroll_drive have closed-form travels (lead, p1-p2, spiral_pitch) and only need a phase. roller_follower already has pose_deg and is not in ANIMATE. peristaltic_pump_head's rotor is a rigid body; one turn closes. archimedes_screw's flight is a helix, so spinning it is not a camera move.

Still true. demo_worm has no measurable conjugate contact (overlap 0). harmonic_drive deforms the cup every frame (bake residual ~0.15 mm). planet_stage is feasible at 2520 deg / 252 frames if the D-flat is dropped for the bake, but the current demo's 1-fold sun makes the short track illegal. intermittent_gear_pair still has no engagement law. collet, leaf/coil/wave/spiral springs, auxetic/kerf deform. jaw_coupling, hirth, timing_pulley, idler_pulley, freewheel (as currently posed) are rigid rotations of the whole assembly. eccentric_idler_mount is a lock-once adjustment.
title: Mechanisms that exist but cannot play
